label: Technology & Making
scope_note: The tools, techniques and systems people use to make, grow, move, compute and build.

label: Engineering
scope_note: Designing and building machines, structures and systems.

label: Civil engineering
scope_note: Roads, bridges, dams, water supply and other infrastructure.

label: Mechanical engineering
scope_note: Machines, engines and mechanical systems.

label: Electrical and electronic engineering
scope_note: Electrical systems, electronics and circuits.

label: Chemical engineering
scope_note: Processes that transform raw materials into products at industrial scale.

label: Aerospace engineering
scope_note: Aircraft and spacecraft.

label: Materials science
scope_note: The properties and design of materials: metals, ceramics, polymers, composites and nanomaterials.

label: Biomedical engineering
scope_note: Engineering applied to medicine and biology: devices, implants, imaging.

label: Robotics
scope_note: Machines that sense, decide and act.

label: Computing and information technology
scope_note: Computers, software, networks and the processing of information.

label: Computer science
scope_note: Computation, algorithms and the theory of what can be computed.

label: Software and programming
scope_note: Programs, programming languages and software engineering.

label: Computer hardware
scope_note: Processors, memory, storage and the architecture of computers.

label: The Internet and the Web
scope_note: The global network of networks and the Web built on it.

label: Artificial intelligence
scope_note: Machines that learn, reason, perceive or use language, and the debates about their effects.

label: Data and databases
scope_note: Storing, organizing, searching and analysing data.

label: Information security and cryptography
scope_note: Protecting information and systems; the mathematics and practice of secret communication.

label: Telecommunications
scope_note: Transmitting information over distance: telegraph, telephone, radio, cable, fibre and satellite.

label: Energy technology
scope_note: Producing, converting, storing and distributing energy.

label: Fossil-fuel energy
scope_note: Energy from coal, oil and natural gas.

label: Nuclear energy
scope_note: Electricity and heat from nuclear fission, and research toward fusion.

label: Renewable energy
scope_note: Energy from sun, wind, water, heat within the Earth and biomass.

label: Electric power systems
scope_note: Generating, transmitting and distributing electricity.

label: Energy storage
scope_note: Batteries and other ways of storing energy.

label: Manufacturing and industry
scope_note: Making goods at scale, and the industries that do it.

label: Metallurgy
scope_note: Extracting, refining and working metals.

label: Textile production
scope_note: Spinning, weaving and finishing fibres into cloth.

label: Printing
scope_note: Reproducing text and images, from woodblocks and movable type to digital printing.

label: Crafts and trades
scope_note: Skilled hand production — carpentry, smithing, pottery, leatherwork, basketry — and its knowledge.

label: Mining and extraction
scope_note: Extracting minerals and fuels from the Earth.

label: Agriculture and food production
scope_note: Growing crops, raising animals and producing food.

label: Crop farming
scope_note: Cultivating crops for food, fibre and fuel.

label: Pastoralism and livestock
scope_note: Raising animals, including nomadic and transhumant pastoralism.

label: Fisheries and aquaculture
scope_note: Catching and farming fish and other aquatic life.

label: Forestry
scope_note: Managing forests for wood and other uses.

label: Farming systems
scope_note: Ways of farming — subsistence and commercial, irrigated and rain-fed, shifting cultivation, terracing, organic and agroecological.

label: Food processing and preservation
scope_note: Preserving and processing food: drying, salting, fermenting, canning, refrigerating.

label: Transport
scope_note: Moving people and goods.

label: Road transport
scope_note: Roads and road vehicles, from carts to cars.

label: Rail transport
scope_note: Railways and trains.

label: Water transport and navigation
scope_note: Boats and ships, ports and navigation.

label: Air transport
scope_note: Aircraft and aviation.

label: Spaceflight and space exploration
scope_note: Travel into and through outer space.

label: Construction and building technology
scope_note: Building structures, from earth and timber to steel and concrete.

label: Military technology
scope_note: Weapons, fortifications and other technology of war.

label: Biotechnology
scope_note: Using living systems and molecules to make products and change organisms.
